riskAssessment.reason: The read model must preserve supplied Top5 facts exactly and deterministically reject duplicate candidate identities without taking ownership of upstream calculations or shared module registration.
riskAssessment.reviewNotes: Candidate identity is the stable entry identity. All seven display facts are opaque validated text values; the read model never ranks or derives them. Shared module registration and coverage policy remain untouched; the user-approved module-local companion test satisfies the existing byModule coverage association.

reasons: Medium-risk bounded-context read model with deterministic local verification.

The user additionally approved the current-WI module-local test scope amendment without changing shared coverage policy.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record checkpoints before implementation and Finish to bind scope and verification evidence.

acceptance: The module exposes validated text values for candidate, company, stage, direction, confidence, key_change, and next with public API documentation; blank-only inputs are rejected while nonblank input is retained exactly.
Top5Entry retains all seven supplied values unchanged and exposes them through accessors without calculating, normalizing, ranking, or inferring any field.
Top5WeeklyReadModel accepts zero through five supplied entries, preserves insertion order, and returns the entries without sorting or changing membership.
Adding a sixth entry returns a deterministic Top5LimitExceeded error and does not mutate the existing read model.
Repeated candidate identity returns a deterministic DuplicateIdentity error and does not mutate the existing read model; duplicate validation is performed before the capacity check.
Focused unit and integration tests verify exact seven-field retention and insertion order.
Focused unit and integration tests verify empty input, five-entry capacity, sixth-entry rejection, duplicate rejection, and non-mutating errors.
The module-local companion test file is loaded by the independent module, matches the existing coverage association, and does not require shared module registration or coverage-policy changes.
Focused source review confirms the independent module has no cross-feature imports and no upstream calculation functions.
The design spec and execution plan record the exclusive write set, current-WI issue policy, authorization, explicit non-goals, and verification commands.
guidelines: Treat all Top5 fields as supplied upstream facts; do not calculate or infer Stage, Direction, Confidence, Key Change, Distance, or membership.
Preserve supplied entry order and exact nonblank text values.
Use candidate identity for duplicate detection and reject duplicates deterministically.
Do not modify shared Weekly Radar module registration or architecture guard files; the parent composition Work Item owns those paths.
Do not add dependencies or import internal modules from other features.
If a problem is discovered within this WI, resolve it in this WI by amending scope/evidence when needed; do not open a new WI merely to contain a current-WI defect.
Do not introduce trading, price prediction, target price, portfolio allocation, or capital-action behavior.

intent.problem: The Weekly Radar Contract now exists, but the Top5-specific weekly output boundary is not yet typed. Later snapshot and renderer Work Items need a deterministic container that consumes already-decided Top5 facts without re-ranking or inventing narrative fields.
constraints: Only the independent top5_weekly_read_model.rs module, its owned module-local companion test, its focused integration test, dedicated docs, and this WI's lifecycle evidence may be changed; shared module registration files are forbidden.
Candidate, company, stage, direction, confidence, key_change, and next are supplied facts. Preserve their exact nonblank values and input order.
The collection is capped at five entries and rejects duplicate candidate identity. Rendering, persistence, scheduling, retry, external systems, and capital decisions remain outside this WI.
intent.rationale: A small read-only boundary lets later Weekly Radar composition consume a stable Top5 projection while preventing a renderer or downstream publisher from silently re-ranking candidates or recalculating research conclusions.
